children: Statement re Notification of Interim Results for the 6 Months Ended June 2026
ICFG Limited (LON: ICFG), the international financial services group, will announce its interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 on Tuesday, 15 September 2026 (the "Announcement").

The Announcement will coincide with the Mongolia Investment Forum: London 2026, where ICFG is a Presenting Partner.  The event is invitation-only, although requests to attend can be made via the following link: Mongolia Investment Forum: London 2026
The Announcement will be available on the Company's website on the day of publication and will include access to a management presentation of the results.
